changelog: Remembers CoverFlow, Grid and List independently for each library. Restores the correct view on navigation, revisits and reloads while preserving Jellyfin native Grid/List settings and existing CoverFlow choices.
description: Adds an accessible CoverFlow browser to Jellyfin Web for existing media libraries. It uses Jellyfin metadata and images without modifying library data.
name: CoverFlow
overview: Browse Jellyfin libraries with a 3D CoverFlow interface.
